chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb or Ibn 'Ammar, from al-Sabbah ibn Sayabah, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said to me: Do not omit the adhan in any of the prayers. But if you do omit it, then do not omit it in Maghrib and Fajr, for there is no shortening in them.

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before salat

ai.seo_question: Should the adhan be omitted in any of the daily prayers, especially Maghrib and Fajr?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs maintaining the adhan in all prayers and gives special emphasis to Maghrib and Fajr. It indicates a legal distinction for these two prayers on the basis that no shortening applies to them.
